summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。

summaries.en: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats like PDFs and Office documents into clean Markdown, solving the problem of extracting structured text from proprietary formats for easier editing and processing. It leverages AI models to intelligently parse document layouts and preserve formatting elements like headings and lists during conversion. You can integrate it into document processing pipelines, use it to convert research papers for analysis, or extend it with custom parsers for specialized document types.
summaries.zh: Markitdown 是一个 Python 工具，能够将 PDF 和 Office 文档等多种文件格式转换为清晰的 Markdown 文本，解决了从专有格式中提取结构化内容的难题。它通过 AI 模型智能解析文档布局，在转换过程中保留标题、列表等关键格式元素，确保输出内容的可读性和可用性。你可以将其集成到文档处理流程中，用于转换研究报告进行文本分析，或扩展自定义解析器来处理特定类型的专业文档，非常适合需要批量处理办公文档的开发者和研究人员。

summaries.en: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers automate routine tasks and understand complex codebases through natural language commands. It works by analyzing your entire code repository context to provide intelligent suggestions and execute commands directly in your development environment. You can use it to generate boilerplate code, debug existing functions, or manage Git workflows—simply type your request in plain English and let it handle the implementation details.
summaries.zh: Claude Code 是一款基于终端的AI编程助手，它通过自然语言命令帮助开发者自动化日常任务并理解复杂代码库。其核心在于能够分析整个代码仓库的上下文，直接在开发环境中提供智能建议并执行命令。你可以用它生成样板代码、调试现有函数或管理Git工作流——只需用简单英语描述需求，它就能处理具体的实现细节，让编程工作更高效直观。

summaries.en: FlClash is a multi-platform proxy client built on ClashMeta, designed to simplify secure network access across devices. Its core strength lies in combining the powerful ClashMeta engine with a clean Flutter UI, supporting protocols like V2Ray, Hysteria, and VLESS. Technically, it offers seamless configuration management and real-time traffic monitoring. You can use it as a daily VPN alternative, deploy it on mobile or desktop, or extend it with custom rules for advanced routing.
summaries.zh: FlClash 是一款基于 ClashMeta 的多平台代理客户端，旨在简化跨设备的网络安全访问。它通过 Flutter 构建了简洁直观的用户界面，同时集成了 ClashMeta 强大的代理引擎，支持 V2Ray、Hysteria、VLESS 等多种协议。其技术亮点在于配置管理的便捷性和实时流量监控功能，让用户无需复杂操作即可实现高效代理。你可以将其作为日常 VPN 替代方案，在手机、电脑上使用，或通过自定义规则实现精细化流量路由，适合需要稳定、灵活代理的个人用户和开发者。

summaries.en: Social-auto-upload is an open-source Python tool that automates video uploading to multiple social media platforms like TikTok, YouTube, and Bilibili, solving the repetitive task of manual cross-posting. Its core strength lies in simulating browser interactions via Selenium, handling platform-specific upload quirks without official APIs. You can integrate it into content pipelines by configuring platform credentials and video metadata, then running scheduled uploads to maintain a consistent multi-platform presence.
summaries.zh: Social-auto-upload 是一个开源 Python 工具，专为自动化视频上传至抖音、小红书、视频号、YouTube、Bilibili 等平台设计，解决跨平台分发时重复手动操作的痛点。其核心技术通过 Selenium 模拟浏览器操作，绕过各平台上传限制与界面差异，无需官方 API 即可稳定上传。用户可配置账号信息与视频元数据，设定定时任务，实现自动分发至多平台，保持更新频率。该工具显著节省时间，适合需同时运营多个社交媒体账号的创作者或团队。

summaries.en: This project offers a complete, beginner-friendly pipeline for training a large language model from scratch. It covers data collection, preprocessing, model architecture design, and text generation, using clear Jupyter notebooks. The key insight is its modular, step-by-step approach that demystifies the entire training process. You can use it to learn LLM fundamentals, experiment with small-scale models, or adapt the code for custom datasets and tasks.
summaries.zh: 该项目提供了一个完整且适合初学者的流水线，用于从头训练大语言模型。它涵盖了数据收集、预处理、模型架构设计和文本生成，全部通过清晰的Jupyter Notebook实现。其核心亮点在于模块化、逐步推进的方式，让整个训练过程不再神秘。你可以用它来学习LLM的基础知识，在小规模模型上进行实验，或根据自定义数据集和任务调整代码。
